remarks: Located close to the ski slopes at HoliMont and Holiday Valley...and the Village of Ellicottville...this inviting chalet-style retreat offers the perfect blend of comfort, privacy, and year-round adventure. Set on approximately 1.65 wooded acres just minutes from HoliMont and the shops, restaurants, and nightlife of Ellicottville, 7289 NYS Route 242 delivers the 4-season resort lifestyle buyers are searching for. Inside, the home features an open-concept layout with soaring cathedral ceilings, warm natural wood accents, and a cozy pellet stove that creates the perfect après-ski atmosphere. The updated kitchen includes granite countertops and newer appliances, flowing easily into the dining and living areas for effortless entertainment. With 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths and a loft space, there’s room for family, guests, or flexible work-from-home living. Outdoor spaces are equally appealing, with covered and open-air decks overlooking the peaceful wooded setting. Whether enjoying morning coffee, hosting friends after a day on the slopes, or relaxing beside the fire on a snowy evening, this property captures the essence of Ellicottville living in every season. Ideal as a primary residence, vacation getaway, or investment opportunity, this home combines convenience, charm, and a highly desirable location close to skiing, golf, hiking, mountain biking, and all the attractions of Ellicottville.
